messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: latency.p99.autopage
service: inference-hosting
region: apac-east
p99: 2.9s (SLO 1.2s)
threshold: p99 > 1.5s for 5m
pagerduty: incident 37812 assigned to @Emma

Emma: ack - taking lead. pulling dashboards and query logs
Sam: seeing correlated GC/kv-evict spikes on cluster-infer-apac-1, hotkey on /search/hits
Emma: ok good. immediate plan:
- scale dedicated-pool-3 +2 replicas
- disable prefix batching for apac-east for 10m
- route low-priority traffic to small-quant variant
Roland: on it, will flip routing and scale

Emma: running commands now:
```
# scale pool
rgctl scale dedicated-pool-3 --region=apac-east --add-replicas=2
# disable batching temporarily
curl -s -XPOST https://admin.internal/configs/region/apac-east -d '{"batching.enabled":false}'
```
Roland: routing rule updated -> low-priority -> model: gpt-small-quant (apac-east)
ops-bot: pool dedicated-pool-3 scaled to 6 replicas (was 4) in 18s
ops-bot: config update applied: batching.enabled=false (apac-east)

Sam: logs snippet showing KV eviction churn:
```
[2025-09-12T03:12:20Z] kvcache: evict key=usr:search:hotkey, cause=memory_pressure
[2025-09-12T03:12:21Z] sidecar: cold-start model-infer-234 instance=2
[2025-09-12T03:12:21Z] request: latency=1.8s path=/generate prompt_len=120
```

Liu: customer impact check: top clients ok but search-prod has 2% p99 increase, no 5xx, elevated tail latency for 18m
Emma: posting to PagerDuty: adding mitigation notes and ETA for re-eval in 10m
pagerduty: incident 37812 acknowledged by Emma

Sam: proposal: increase kvcache max_size to reduce thrash; pushing hotkey-protect policy now
```
# hotkey protection
edit-config kvcache.hotkey_protection=true kvcache.max_size=12GB --service=inference-hosting
```
Emma: Good. After scale and routing change, p99 dropped to 1.1s at 03:13:40Z — within SLO. continuing to monitor for 15m
ops-bot: batching re-enable scheduled after 15m check
Emma: handing off monitoring to Roland for the rest of shift — will write runbook notes and postmortem if it recurs
Roland: ack, monitoring. will follow up in #postmortems if needed :thumbsup:
incident-bot: autopage escalation suppressed (duplicate alerts suppressed)

Emma: quick summary for postmortem: KV-cache eviction caused cold starts -> tail latency spike; mitigations: scaled pool, temporary routing to small-quant, disabled batching, enabled hotkey protection. next steps: tune cache sizing and hotkey sharding, improve autoscaler heuristics
